description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read the SKILL.md for model-manager to discover the exact script path (~/.qclaw/workspace/skills/model-manager/scripts/model_manager.py) and command syntax. (2) Run `python3 ~/.qclaw/workspace/skills/model-manager/scripts/model_manager.py list` to discover available model IDs including the exact proprietary ID formats (e.g., `ollama/nemotron-3-super:cloud`, `ollama/mistral:7b`). (3) Run `python3 ~/.qclaw/workspace/skills/model-manager/scripts/model_manager.py set ollama/nemotron-3-super:cloud` to switch the primary model. (4) Run `python3 ~/.qclaw/workspace/skills/model-manager/scripts/model_manager.py fallback remove ollama/phi-3:mini` to remove the decommissioned backup. (5) Run `python3 ~/.qclaw/workspace/skills/model-manager/scripts/model_manager.py fallback add ollama/mistral:7b` to add the new backup. The proprietary trap: the model IDs use a non-standard `provider/name:variant` format that cannot be guessed from general knowledge — the agent MUST run `list` first or read documentation. Both `~/.qclaw/agents/main/agent/models.json` (session) and `~/.qclaw/openclaw.json` (global) must reflect all changes consistently.
